newsitem.title: USA: State Farm gearing up for Hurricane Fran claims.
newsitem.headline: State Farm gearing up for Hurricane Fran claims.

text.p: State Farm Insurance said it is beefing up the number of claims adjustors and agents by 600 in the wake of Hurricane Fran.

By Monday morning the company that identifies itself as the nation's largest insurer of homes and cars said it expects to have a total of 2,200 personnel in place throughout North Carolina, Virginia and parts of South Carolina.
John Dosen, who heads the company's catastrophe response effort, said it was too early to estimate how many claims it will handle or the dollar amounts involved.
"We're geared up to handle as many as 50,000 claims in the storm area, and we're calculating that about 80 percent of them will be in North Carolina," Dosen said in a statement.

State Farm said it has 434,000 homeowners and commercial policies and 875,000 auto policies in North Carolina. It has 555,000 homeowners and commercial policies and one million auto policies in Virginia.
